final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.SEX, CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM sex_averages), kept AS (SELECT s.avg_ratio FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(k.avg_ratio - f.value) AS average_excess_first_mean, AVG(k.avg_ratio - s.value) AS average_excess_second_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.value
